Contributors / 撰稿人

This collection features 97 essays from dozens of engineering leaders around the world, including Marcus Blankenship, Camille Fournier, Cate Huston, Gojko Adzic, John Allspaw, Camille's colleagues at Two Sigma, Rent the Runway, GitHub, Google, Amazon, Facebook, and many other companies. Each chapter is credited to its author at the top of that chapter.

本合集收录了来自全球数十位工程领导的 97 篇短文，包括 Marcus Blankenship、Camille Fournier、Cate Huston、Gojko Adzic、John Allspaw，以及 Two Sigma、Rent the Runway、GitHub、Google、Amazon、Facebook 等公司的众多从业者。每章作者署名见各章开头。

The complete contributor biographies appear on pages 268–285 of the original print edition; this HTML edition links each chapter to its author credit inline.

完整的撰稿人简介见原书印刷版第 268–285 页；本 HTML 版在各章开头行内标注作者。

— 第 286 页 —

Index / 索引

The original book includes a detailed subject index on pages 286–294. In this HTML edition, please use your browser's Find (Ctrl/Cmd+F) to search chapter text, or click any topic in the left sidebar TOC to jump to that chapter.

原书第 286–294 页有详细主题索引。在本 HTML 版中，请使用浏览器查找 (Ctrl/Cmd+F) 搜索章节正文，或点击左侧目录跳转对应章节。

— 第 295 页 —

About the Editor / 关于编者

Camille Fournier is an engineering executive and author of The Manager's Path (O'Reilly) as well as the editor of this collection. She is a member of the engineering leadership team at Two Sigma, overseeing the firm's platform engineering organization, and is the former CTO of Rent the Runway.

Camille Fournier 是工程高管，著有《技术管理之路》(The Manager's Path, O'Reilly)，也是本合集的编者。她是 Two Sigma 工程领导团队成员，负责公司平台工程组织，曾任 Rent the Runway CTO。

Thank you for reading this bilingual HTML edition. Happy managing!

感谢阅读本中英对照 HTML 版。祝管理愉快！
